assertions.name: single_magic_anchors_falsify_refined_formula
assertions.source: Single-magic gaps: (2,1)=+8.74%, (1,2)=-3.95%, both above 1% threshold. The refined pp-nn correlation formula (probe_delta_coupling_pp_nn_correlation) is empirically wrong at single-magic anchors.

description: Cross-anchor Δ_coupling test using Δ_cat data from magic-shell-empirical-instantiation.witness.json on main. REFUTES the pp-nn correlation hypothesis shipped earlier on PR #671 (probe_delta_coupling_pp_nn_correlation): single-magic anchors (2,1) and (1,2) miss the leading-form prediction by 4-9% in OPPOSITE directions, with a Z↔N asymmetry that the symmetric (A-2) factor cannot capture. The doubly-magic (2,2) match was coincidence; the actual decomposition involves single-magic asymmetric pp/nn terms plus a much larger correlation term (~70× larger than hypothesised). conj:delta-coupling-substrate-form needs reformulation.
caveats: This probe REFUTES a hypothesis shipped earlier on the same PR (#671). The doubly-magic (2,2) 0.04% match in the prior probe was coincidence; the structural decomposition is richer than the symmetric (A-2) form. The conj:delta-coupling-substrate-form content block remains a conjecture (was never promoted to proposition) — this finding now constrains its next iteration. Honest empirical signal preserved.
